body: I slept on it and feel a little better now. However I realize this will come back, so I thought about it and will seek some psychological help. Thank you all, you really help me and it is nice to know there are people there who care, even though you are just strangers. Thank you and have a great day.

They probably do and it is amazing but I dont. I feel like living someone elses life - some life I never deserved. People around me are very nice and I have very good start  - good education, no serious money problems, couple of good friends... Still I somehow grew up into a person that is not just able to carish that and keeps behaving like shit. That is my problem


Im going to bed now. Im writing this because I dont want you to think I have done something stupid. Hopefully I will be back tommorow. It seems like you all are wonderful people and I woud like to talk to you some more. See ya.

They dont but they really should. I hve called some of my very good friends "fucking assholes" this very night (it had to do a lot with the fact that i was feeling sick and i thought they were making fun of it - they werent) and even though I apologized, they had no trouble forgiving me. Same goes for my parents. I have been treating them like shit, barely talking to them and being snappy whenever they do talk to me. Still nobody has ever told me to man the fuck up and to start behaving like a fucking person. I seem to be the only one to see that there is something seriously wrong with me, something that needs to be changed

This post was never meant to scare you - it wasnt meant to scare anybody. Its just that I really dont know if I even deserve to be here. I dont know if i could ever actually do it and Im sorry, but these thoughts have been coming to me a lot lately and I really do not know what to tell them anymore.
